newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait bourse warns UAE firm over annual results.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait bourse warns UAE firm over annual results.

text.p: The Kuwait Stock Exchange (KSE) has warned the United Arab Emirates' Umm al-Quwain Cement Comapny that it will suspend its shares if it did not present its 1996 results to KSE by April 15, an official said on Monday.
"KSE has asked the company to comply with the regulations and announce its results," an official said. "If it does not present its results by April 15 the share will be suspended."
Dealers said the firm was heavily traded amid expectations of high 1996 profits.
Its share closed at 99 fils ($0.33) on Monday rising one fils from Sunday. It reached its year high of 104 fils on March 30. There are 1,000 fils to the dinar.
